title: My account
balanceNote: Virtual in-app coins for scratch tickets only — no cash value: they can't be bought, withdrawn, transferred or exchanged.

empty.Waiting: No tickets waiting for results. Check a ticket before the draw and tap "Save", or add one by hand.
empty.Won: None of your saved tickets have won yet.
empty.Lost: No saved tickets have results yet.

saved.confirmDelete: Remove ticket {{number}} from your saved list?

form.notePlaceholder: e.g. bought at Ben Thanh market

historyEmpty: You haven't checked any tickets yet. Tickets you check while logged in are saved here.
nothingYet: Nothing is available for accounts yet.

game.title: Race for coins
game.rule: Dodge obstacles and grab coins. Each point pays {{perPoint}} coins, up to {{max}} coins per game.
game.noneLeft: No rewarded games left today — you can still play, but without coins. Come back tomorrow!
game.howTo: Your car drives itself and keeps speeding up. Switch lanes to dodge barriers: +1 point per row passed, +1 per gold coin. Hit a barrier and it's over — 90 seconds max.
game.controls: Tap the left / right half of the track, or use the ← → keys to switch lanes.
game.ready: Ready? Tap Start — the car moves after a 3-second countdown.
game.mismatch: The server's score differs from the one on screen — the server's score counts.

shop.title: Buy 2-digit scratch tickets
shop.rule: Random number 00–99. Match the 8th prize of your chosen province to win {{prize}} coins (pays {{multiplier}} to 1).
shop.insufficient: Not enough balance. Contact the admin to get credit.
shop.insufficientGame: Not enough coins. Play the minigame to earn more!

ticket.empty: You don't have any tickets yet. Pick a province and buy one above!
ticket.refunded: No result for this province — refunded {{amount}} coins
